Context: 3. Calculation from old Headquarters only

## 3. Calculation from old Headquarters only  
To be calculated from the old headquarters in all cases, including-  
- (a) Where an employee receives the orders in a place other than his headquarters;
- (b) Where charge of the old post is made over in a place other than the headquarters.
- (c) Where the headquarters is changed while on tour to the station of tour itself; and  
- (d) Where the temporary transfer is converted into permanent transfer. · - Rule 5 (2).
